summary: Kiley joined an AIPAC-organized delegation to Israel in April 2024, stating support for Israel's right to defend itself and calling October 7 'barbarity and evil.' He praised Yale's crackdown on pro-Palestine encampment protests, framing them as anti-Israel. He voted Yea on the Antisemitism Awareness Act and sponsors its 2025 version, H.R. 1007, embedding the IHRA definition in Title VI education enforcement. In an August 2026 debate, he pressed his opponent to answer whether Israel's actions constitute genocide rather than stating his own view.
